dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Ah... I suppose people nowadays wouldn't know. In my time, three bright moons still hung in the sky, and upon each resided many lunar envoys.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: Back then, noble souls did not head for the depths of the ancient tree. Instead, they followed the trail of the envoys to sleep eternally in the cities upon the moons.

dialogues.speaker: Diotima
dialogues.text: I never actually visited the moons myself, but it must be a place as peaceful as it is here.
